organization.name: Node-RED / OpenJS Foundation
organization.notes: Project began2013 at IBM; OpenJS Foundation project, rather than FlowFuse-owned software. Equity funding is not applicable to the project; sponsor financing is not project equity.

pricingTiers.name: Node-RED core
pricingTiers.notes: Apache-licensed project runtime; commercial products built around it are distinct.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended plan designation verified in the pricing source; no plan inferred.
No project business license tier listed. FlowFuse commercial platform is a separate product, not substituted.
No project enterprise license tier listed; downstream commercial offerings are separate.

moats.claim: A mature edge-automation node and flow ecosystem creates reusable know-how and compatibility value; open JSON flows also reduce lock-in.

productReasons.claim: Wire message-driven processes visually and insert JavaScript functions where logic needs code.
Integrate device and service protocols through a community palette of thousands of nodes.
Share and reuse JSON flows through import/export and the public flow library.

sponsorship.notes: Corporate sponsorship source checked. Listed organizations explicitly support the project; customers and investors excluded.

requirements.notes: Current docs recommend Node24; Node-RED5.x needs Node22 minimum,4.x needs18. Installed third-party nodes can have additional requirements.
Official container bundles runtime; external Node.js install unnecessary for this route.
Flows/settings stored on disk; default context memory. No SQL database/cache/queue required for core.

requirements.condition: Git Projects, native add-on nodes or selected integration flows
requirements.notes: Git for Projects; gcc for native components; MQTT/database/API services only as chosen flows require.

resources.notes: Hardware minima not specified in the checked deployment source; size for workload.

selfHosting.notes: Core is a Node.js event-driven server with browser editor; not a central SQL-backed SaaS clone. Secure editor/HTTP endpoints for production. No generic external Redis, SQL or SMTP service is required by core.

options.name: npm global installation
options.notes: One npm installation command after installing supported Node.js; run node-red separately.

oneClickInstall.notes: Only verified official deployment options included; one-command installers labelled separately from one-click. Manual Docker Compose alone is not counted as one-click.
